ios.desc:
This app supports Looker (Original) users only 
Login to your instance using email/password or QR code
- Access Dashboards and Looks from boards, favorites, recently viewed or through search
- Easily filter Dashboards and Looks to focus on the data that matters most to you
- Seamlessly share insights with colleagues to keep everyone on the same page
*Requires Looker login

Mobile Governing Agreement: https://looker.com/trust-center/legal/customers/mobile-governing-agreement
